entries.title: Psion discipline spell references
entries.summary: Repair Wall of Fire, Cause Fear, Rary's Telepathic Bond, and Banishment grants.
entries.rationale: Cause Fear's source prefix and Rary's Telepathic Bond's ID are strong matches. Wall of Flame to Wall of Fire and Banish to Banishment are reviewed local inferences explicitly accepted by the maintainer after checking alternatives; they are not confirmed upstream author intent.

corrections.reason: 2026-10-06 user-authorized local repair. User checked and confirmed Wall of Fire as the intended spell. ID_PHB_SPELL_WALL_OF_FLAME -> ID_PHB_SPELL_WALL_OF_FIRE. Not accepted upstream.

2026-10-06 user-authorized local repair. User checked and confirmed Banishment as the intended spell. ID_PHB_SPELL_BANISH -> ID_PHB_SPELL_BANISHMENT. Not accepted upstream.

entries.title: Stoneheart Erupting Earth reference
entries.summary: Point Stoneheart's missing Erupting Earth grant to the Xanathar's spell definition.
entries.rationale: No custom Erupting Earth definition was present in the reviewed Stoneheart source. This proposal uses the maintainer's preferred Xanathar's Guide to Everything definition while preserving the distinct Princes of the Apocalypse definition. This is a reviewed assumption pending author confirmation, not an upstream-accepted correction.

corrections.reason: User-authorized local correction: Stoneheart is unresolved KibblesTasty homebrew and declares no custom Erupting Earth spell. Use Xanathar's Guide to Everything (ID_XGTE_SPELL_ERUPTING_EARTH) as the assumed first-party reference. Preserve the distinct Princes of the Apocalypse definition. Pending confirmation with KibblesTasty; this is not an upstream-accepted correction.
